root_cause: The canonical social publisher was protected by single-writer and provider-readback gates, but the Netlify recovery supervisor only retried once per hour. A missed 08:00 Europe/Amsterdam publication could therefore remain visibly absent for too long even when healthy provider connections were available.
prevention_rule: Keep exactly one canonical provider writer, but invoke its idempotent recovery supervisor at a bounded ten-minute cadence and once after every production deploy. Never bypass daily uniqueness, capability consumption, exact-content identity or provider readback gates.
